description: Pull observations across one or more studies and pivot them into a germplasm × trait matrix materialized as a canvas dataframe. Returns a dataframe handle (query with brapi_dataframe_query) plus a summary of dimensions and aggregate method. Long-form output is suitable for downstream GROUP BY analysis by study, germplasm, or variable.

aggregate.description: How to aggregate replicate observations (multiple readings of the same variable on the same germplasm). `mean` and `median` attempt numeric conversion and skip non-numeric values (e.g. categorical traits). `first` keeps the first value seen. `all` keeps every replicate as a separate row (produces long-form output even when shape is "wide"). Default: `mean`.

alias.description: Connection alias registered via brapi_connect. Omit to read the connection registered under alias `default` — i.e. a prior brapi_connect call that did not specify an alias. Calls that used a non-default alias must pass that same alias here.

extraFilters.description: Extra BrAPI filters forwarded verbatim. Valid keys vary by endpoint; brapi_describe_filters enumerates them. Named params on this tool take precedence on conflict.

germplasm.description: Optional subset of germplasmDbIds to include. Omit to include all germplasm found in the queried studies.

loadLimit.description: Cap on rows returned inline. Omit for the deployment default. Rows beyond the cap land in a dataframe; query with brapi_dataframe_query (SQL) instead of paging row-by-row.

shape.description: Matrix shape. `wide` — one row per germplasm, one column per variable, cell = aggregated value. `long` — one row per observation with columns: germplasmDbId, observationVariableDbId, studyDbId, value, replicateIndex. When `aggregate:"all"` is combined with `shape:"wide"`, the output falls back to long form with a replicateIndex column.

studies.description: studyDbIds to include in the matrix. At least one is required — the tool is study-anchored to avoid full-table scans.

variables.description: Optional subset of observationVariableDbIds to include. Omit to include all variables found in the queried studies.

name: brapi_build_phenotype_matrix

aggregate.description: Aggregation applied to replicate observations (wide shape only). `all` keeps one row per replicate.

alias.description: Alias of the registered BrAPI connection the call used.

cap.description: Per-study observation cap that was applied.

dataframe.description: Canvas dataframe handle for the materialized matrix. Omitted when no observations were found. Query with brapi_dataframe_query (SQL). Long-form columns: germplasmDbId, observationVariableDbId, studyDbId, value, replicateIndex. Wide-form columns: germplasmDbId, germplasmName, one column per variable (SQL-safe identifier derived from observationVariableDbId — see variableLegend).

columnLegend.description: Maps a sanitized column name back to its original upstream key, for columns renamed to clear the SQL-safe-identifier gate (e.g. `end` → `end_`). Present only when a column was renamed — write SQL against the sanitized (left-hand) names.

columns.description: Full column list of the dataframe.

items.description: Column name from the materialized rows.

createdAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp the dataframe was created.

expiresAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp after which the dataframe metadata will be purged. Re-run the find_* tool to refresh, or copy results out before expiry.

maxRows.description: Cap that was applied at create time, when truncation occurred.

rowCount.description: Number of rows materialized in the dataframe.

tableName.description: Dataframe name. Use with brapi_dataframe_describe (schema + provenance) and brapi_dataframe_query (SQL).

totalCount.description: Total rows reported by the upstream server (may exceed rowCount when truncated).

truncated.description: True when the dataframe hit a row cap before exhausting upstream.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `unknown_alias`: No connection has been registered under the requested alias. `all_filters_dropped`: The active dialect dropped every filter supplied — the call would silently widen to the unfiltered baseline. `no_observation_path`: Neither /observations nor /observationunits returned data for any requested study after probing both paths. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

germplasmCount.description: Number of distinct germplasm in the matrix.

notice.description: Guidance for reaching the observations this call left out.

observationCount.description: Total raw observations collected before pivoting.

shape.description: Matrix shape — wide (one row per germplasm, one column per variable) or long (one row per observation).

shown.description: Observations collected across all studies after filtering.

studies.description: studyDbIds that were queried to build the matrix.

truncated.description: True when at least one study saturated the per-study loadLimit.

variableCount.description: Number of distinct observation variables in the matrix.

variableLegend.description: Mapping of safe column identifier → observationVariableName. Wide-matrix column names are SQL-safe identifiers derived from observationVariableDbId (sanitized for DuckDB); consult this map to resolve a column back to its variable display name.

warnings.description: Advisory messages (empty studies, non-numeric aggregation skips, fallback paths).

title: Brapi Build Phenotype Matrix
